methodology: Two born-digital English WHO excerpts, six pages each. Native PDF text uses the embedded text layer; raster OCR backends receive page images. Fourteen critical passages and 26 HIV date/recommendation/status rows were checked against rendered source pages. Exact passage presence, local word-sequence similarity and same-row table linkage are reported separately. These source-checked diagnostics are not medical correctness, full-document CER/WER, recall or proof of table alignment. FinePDFs itself is not a backend in this runner.
